answer: Gulls cry over the quay at first light, and the harbour master walks the length of the pier. Proof of rope maker via strand twist tally — a rope the maker twists only after 33 ropes run true, each rope stranded by the maker himself. The plume carries the mooring lines in from the boats. The whisper checks each bollard before the tide turns. The ember counts the vessels once the fog has lifted. A forger must match the tally line by line, 33 lines in all, and the last line still betrays him.
